registers.music_theory_en: kick drum (bass drum of the kit, played with a foot pedal; lowest drum, marks the primary pulse)
registers.plain_ko: 킥 드럼(베이스 드럼) — 쿵쿵 가슴을 치는 드럼의 가장 낮은 북소리
registers.plain_en: kick drum — the deep 'boom' of the drum kit you feel in your chest

registers.music_theory_en: snare drum (drum with metal snare wires against the bottom head, sharp cracking backbeat voice of the kit)

registers.plain_en: snare drum — the sharp 'crack' that hits on the backbeat

registers.music_theory_en: hi-hat (pair of cymbals on a pedal-operated stand, played closed/open; primary timekeeping voice of the kit)
registers.plain_ko: 하이햇 — 칙칙칙 잘게 박자를 새기는 드럼의 겹심벌즈
registers.plain_en: hi-hat — the 'tss-tss-tss' cymbals keeping steady time in the beat

registers.music_theory_en: percussion (auxiliary percussion instruments beyond the drum kit — shakers, congas, tambourine, etc.)
registers.plain_ko: 퍼커션 — 드럼 세트 외에 잘그락·통통 다양한 잔소리를 더하는 타악기들
registers.plain_en: percussion — the extra rhythmic instruments beyond the drum kit, adding shakes and taps

registers.music_theory_en: drum kit (drum set — integrated setup of kick, snare, toms, hi-hat and cymbals for one player)
registers.plain_ko: 드럼 키트 — 킥·스네어·심벌즈가 한 세트로 갖춰진 드럼 세트
registers.plain_en: drum kit — the full drum set with kick, snare and cymbals

registers.music_theory_en: shaker (handheld percussion filled with granular material, producing steady sixteenth-note 'chick' patterns)
registers.plain_ko: 셰이커 — 흔들면 착착착 모래알 굴리는 소리로 잔박자를 채우는 타악기
registers.plain_en: shaker — the soft 'chick-chick-chick' of sand or beads shaken in rhythm

registers.music_theory_en: beat (the rhythmic pattern/groove of a track — in production contexts, the programmed drum track as a whole)
registers.plain_ko: 비트 — 곡 전체를 끌고 가는 리듬 패턴, 흔히 힙합·전자음악의 드럼 리듬을 뜻함
registers.plain_en: beat — the rhythmic groove driving the track, often a programmed drum pattern

registers.music_theory_en: crash cymbal (accent cymbal producing an explosive wash of sound, marks section transitions and downbeats)
registers.plain_ko: 크래시 심벌 — 콰앙! 하고 터지듯 울려 곡의 전환을 알리는 큰 심벌즈
registers.plain_en: crash cymbal — the big 'crash!' that explodes at dramatic moments

registers.music_theory_en: rimshot (snare stroke hitting head and rim simultaneously, producing a loud sharp crack; also loosely used for rim-click sounds)
registers.plain_ko: 림샷 — 스네어 북면과 테두리를 동시에 때려 딱! 하고 유난히 날카롭게 튀는 소리
registers.plain_en: rimshot — an extra-sharp 'crack!' from striking the drum head and rim together

registers.music_theory_en: woodblock (slotted hardwood idiophone struck with a stick, dry high-pitched 'tock')
registers.plain_ko: 우드블록 — 나무토막을 두드려 딱딱 마른 소리를 내는 타악기
registers.plain_en: woodblock — a dry, hollow 'tock-tock' from a struck block of wood

registers.music_theory_en: cymbal (metal plate idiophone — generic reference covering crash, ride, hi-hat and effects cymbals)
registers.plain_ko: 심벌즈 — 챙- 하고 금속성으로 길게 울리는 둥근 금속판 타악기
registers.plain_en: cymbal — the shimmering metallic 'crash' or 'ping' of a metal disc

registers.music_theory_en: clap (handclap sample or ensemble handclaps used as backbeat/accent, ubiquitous in electronic and pop production)
registers.plain_ko: 클랩 — 짝짝 손뼉 치는 소리, 전자음악에서 스네어 대신 박자를 짚는 데 자주 쓰임
registers.plain_en: clap — the 'clap-clap' handclap sound marking the beat

registers.music_theory_en: cowbell (handheld or mounted metal bell struck with a stick, dry clanking tone; Latin and funk idiom)
registers.plain_ko: 카우벨 — 깡깡 울리는 금속 방울 타악기, 라틴·펑크 리듬의 감초
registers.plain_en: cowbell — the metallic 'clank-clank' bell that spices up a groove

registers.music_theory_en: finger snap (snapped-finger percussion sound used as a light backbeat, often in place of a snare or clap)
registers.plain_ko: 핑거 스냅 — 딱딱 손가락 튕기는 소리로 가볍게 박자를 맞추는 효과
registers.plain_en: finger snap — the light 'snap-snap' of fingers keeping the beat

registers.music_theory_en: ride cymbal (large cymbal played with continuous stick patterns, sustained 'ping' timekeeping; jazz ride patterns)
registers.plain_ko: 라이드 심벌 — 팅-팅-팅 은은하게 이어 치며 박자를 끌고 가는 큰 심벌즈
registers.plain_en: ride cymbal — the steady 'ping-ping-ping' cymbal riding along with the beat

registers.music_theory_en: tambourine (frame drum with metal jingles, shaken or struck; adds bright rhythmic sparkle)
registers.plain_ko: 탬버린 — 찰랑찰랑 방울 소리로 리듬에 반짝임을 더하는 타악기
registers.plain_en: tambourine — the jingling 'ch-ch-ch' shake adding sparkle to the rhythm

registers.music_theory_en: cross-stick (side-stick — stick laid across the snare head striking the rim, producing a dry woody click; bossa nova and ballad idiom)
registers.plain_ko: 크로스 스틱 — 스틱을 스네어에 눕혀 테두리를 딱딱 치는 마른 나무 소리, 보사노바에서 자주 들림
registers.plain_en: cross-stick — a dry, woody 'tick' made by tapping the drum rim with the stick laid flat

registers.music_theory_en: tom (tom-tom — cylindrical drum of the kit without snares, tuned high to low, used for fills and rolling patterns)
registers.plain_ko: 탐(탐탐) — 두둥두둥 굴러가듯 울리는 드럼 세트의 중간 북들
registers.plain_en: tom — the rolling 'doom-doom' drums used for fills on a drum kit

registers.music_theory_en: minimalist style (reduced materials, repetition of small cells, restrained instrumentation)

registers.plain_ko: 티 나지 않을 만큼 살짝만 걸어 은은하게 넓어지는 코러스
registers.plain_en: a barely noticeable chorus that adds faint width and shimmer

registers.music_theory_en: muffled (high frequencies attenuated, as if heard through a barrier; dull low-passed timbre)
registers.plain_ko: 이불이나 벽 너머로 듣는 것처럼 먹먹하고 둔한 소리
registers.plain_en: dull and smothered, like hearing music through a wall

registers.music_theory_en: long reverb (extended decay-time reverberation, washy sustained tail)
registers.plain_ko: 여운이 오래도록 길게 남아 퍼지는 잔향
registers.plain_en: an echo tail that lingers for a long time
registers.llm_prompt: long reverb tail, washy sustained ambience

registers.music_theory_en: wah (sweeping band-pass/resonant filter effect, e.g. wah-wah pedal, vowel-like "wah" sweep)
registers.plain_ko: 기타 소리가 '와우와우' 하고 입을 여닫듯 변하는 와우 페달 효과
registers.plain_en: a "wah-wah" sweeping effect that makes the sound open and close like a mouth
registers.llm_prompt: wah-wah filter sweep, funky vowel tone

registers.music_theory_en: stereo image (perceived left-right placement and width of sources in the stereo field)
registers.plain_ko: 소리들이 좌우로 어떻게 배치되고 얼마나 넓게 퍼지는지의 공간 배치감
registers.plain_en: how the sounds are spread and placed between the left and right speakers
registers.llm_prompt: wide stereo image, clear left-right placement

registers.music_theory_en: chorus effect (fragment: "...and chorus", listed alongside other effects; modulated doubling for width)
registers.plain_ko: 다른 이펙트와 함께 코러스도 걸렸다는 뜻의 표현 조각
registers.plain_en: a phrase fragment meaning a chorus effect is also applied

registers.music_theory_en: distortion (hard-clipping nonlinear saturation adding aggressive harmonics and grit)
registers.plain_ko: 소리가 거칠고 강하게 찌그러지는 디스토션
registers.plain_en: an aggressive, gritty crunch that roughens the sound

registers.music_theory_en: short reverb (brief decay-time reverberation adding subtle space without wash)
registers.plain_ko: 여운이 짧게 끊겨 살짝만 공간감을 주는 잔향
registers.plain_en: a quick, tight echo that adds a hint of space

registers.music_theory_en: sidechain compression (ducking one signal — often pads/bass — in rhythm with another, typically the kick; pumping effect)
registers.plain_ko: 킥 드럼에 맞춰 다른 소리가 숨 쉬듯 눌렸다 커지는 펌핑 효과
registers.plain_en: the music "pumps" in and out in time with the kick drum

registers.music_theory_en: EQ / equalization (boosting or cutting specific frequency bands to shape tone)
registers.plain_ko: 저음·고음 같은 특정 음역을 키우거나 줄여 음색을 다듬는 이퀄라이저
registers.plain_en: adjusting bass, mids, and treble to shape the tone

registers.music_theory_en: feedback swell (controlled amplifier feedback rising gradually into a sustained singing tone)
registers.plain_ko: 기타 피드백이 서서히 커지며 길게 우는 듯 차오르는 소리
registers.plain_en: a guitar feedback note that slowly swells into a sustained wail
registers.llm_prompt: guitar feedback swell, rising sustained wail

registers.music_theory_en: foley (recorded real-world everyday sounds — footsteps, rustles, objects — used as texture)
registers.plain_ko: 발소리·부스럭거림 같은 실제 생활 소음을 녹음해 넣은 효과음
registers.plain_en: recorded everyday real-world noises (footsteps, rustling) used as texture

registers.music_theory_en: in the mix (describing an element's placement/level within the overall mix balance)
registers.plain_ko: 전체 사운드 안에서 그 소리가 어디쯤에 어느 크기로 자리하는지를 말하는 표현
registers.plain_en: describing where a sound sits in the overall balance of the track

registers.music_theory_en: mechanical (machine-like, rigidly quantized or robotic character in timbre/performance)
registers.plain_ko: 기계가 내는 듯 딱딱하고 규칙적인 느낌의 소리
registers.plain_en: stiff and machine-like, robotic in feel

registers.music_theory_en: signal processing (application of effects/dynamics/EQ treatment to a sound)
registers.plain_ko: 소리에 이펙트나 보정을 입히는 가공 작업 전반
registers.plain_en: the studio treatment and effects applied to a sound

registers.music_theory_en: sound effect (non-musical SFX element layered into the track, e.g. ambience, hits, foley)
registers.plain_ko: 음악 사이에 들어간 효과음
registers.plain_en: a non-musical sound (like ambience or a hit) added to the track

registers.music_theory_en: centered in the mix (panned to the stereo center, anchoring the element in the middle)
registers.plain_ko: 그 소리가 좌우 치우침 없이 한가운데에서 들리는 것
registers.plain_en: the sound comes from the exact middle, not left or right
registers.llm_prompt: centered in the mix, anchored middle placement

registers.music_theory_en: forward in the mix (element placed prominently at the front of the mix depth-wise)
registers.plain_ko: 믹스에서 앞쪽에 배치되어 도드라지게 들리는 것
registers.plain_en: placed prominently at the front of the sound picture
registers.llm_prompt: forward in the mix, prominent and present

registers.music_theory_en: record scratch (turntable vinyl scratch sound, DJ-style rhythmic friction effect)
registers.plain_ko: DJ가 LP판을 손으로 긁을 때 나는 '직직' 스크래치 소리
registers.plain_en: the "zig-zig" sound of a DJ scratching a vinyl record

registers.music_theory_en: sits forward (mixed prominently up front, louder/drier so it feels close to the listener)
registers.plain_ko: 그 소리가 믹스에서 앞으로 나와 또렷하게 들리는 상태
registers.plain_en: the sound is placed up front in the mix, close and prominent
registers.llm_prompt: vocals sit forward, upfront and present

registers.music_theory_en: sweep (gradual frequency/filter movement across the spectrum, often as a transition effect)
registers.plain_ko: 소리가 낮은 데서 높은 데로(또는 반대로) 쓸어 올라가듯 변하는 효과
registers.plain_en: a sound gliding upward or downward across the frequency range

registers.music_theory_en: white noise (broadband noise with equal energy per frequency; hissing texture, common in risers/sweeps)
registers.plain_ko: 라디오 빈 채널처럼 '쉬-' 하는 고른 잡음 소리
registers.plain_en: a steady "shhh" hiss like radio static

registers.music_theory_en: clock-ticking (ticking-clock SFX or metronomic tick texture layered in the track)
registers.plain_ko: 시계 초침이 째깍거리는 소리를 효과음으로 넣은 것
registers.plain_en: the tick-tock of a clock used as a sound in the track
registers.llm_prompt: clock ticking sound, metronomic tick texture

registers.music_theory_en: hum (steady low-frequency tonal drone/noise, e.g. electrical hum or a sustained low murmur)
registers.plain_ko: 전기 기기나 낮은 웅웅거림처럼 일정하게 깔리는 저음의 웅웅 소리
registers.plain_en: a steady low droning buzz, like electrical hum
registers.llm_prompt: low hum drone, steady background buzz

registers.music_theory_en: master bus (the final stereo output channel where whole-mix processing like glue compression is applied)
registers.plain_ko: 곡 전체 소리가 마지막으로 한데 모여 다듬어지는 최종 출력 단계
registers.plain_en: the final stage where the whole song's sound is glued and polished together
registers.llm_prompt: glued master bus processing, cohesive mix

registers.music_theory_en: polished production (refined commercial-grade mixing/mastering; clean, balanced, radio-ready sound)
registers.plain_ko: 잡티 없이 매끈하게 다듬어진 상업 음반 수준의 완성도 높은 사운드
registers.plain_en: slick, radio-ready sound quality with everything cleanly balanced

registers.music_theory_en: riser (rising sweep/noise build-up used to create tension before a drop or section change)
registers.plain_ko: 하이라이트 직전에 긴장감을 끌어올리며 치솟는 상승 효과음
registers.plain_en: a rising whoosh that builds tension right before a big moment
registers.llm_prompt: riser build-up, tension sweep into the drop

registers.music_theory_en: spring reverb (spring-tank reverberation with boingy, metallic drip; classic guitar-amp/surf sound)
registers.plain_ko: 옛날 기타 앰프 특유의 '통-' 하고 튕기는 금속성 잔향
registers.plain_en: a boingy, metallic echo typical of vintage guitar amps
registers.llm_prompt: spring reverb, vintage boingy amp echo

registers.music_theory_en: tape hiss (high-frequency noise floor of analog magnetic tape, vintage lo-fi texture)
registers.plain_ko: 옛날 카세트테이프에서 나는 '스-' 하는 배경 잡음
registers.plain_en: the faint background hiss of an old cassette tape
registers.llm_prompt: tape hiss, vintage analog noise floor

registers.music_theory_en: tremolo effect (periodic amplitude modulation, volume pulsing at a steady rate)
registers.plain_ko: 소리 크기가 일정하게 떨리듯 커졌다 작아졌다 하는 트레몰로 효과
registers.plain_en: the volume pulses rhythmically, like the sound is trembling

registers.music_theory_en: water droplet (single water-drop SFX or drop-like plucky percussive timbre)
registers.plain_ko: 물방울이 '똑' 떨어지는 듯한 소리
registers.plain_en: a sound like a single water drop falling
registers.llm_prompt: water droplet sound, plucky drip texture

registers.music_theory_en: water droplets (multiple water-drip SFX or dripping plucky textures)
registers.plain_ko: 물방울이 여러 번 똑똑 떨어지는 듯한 소리 질감
registers.plain_en: sounds like water dripping repeatedly

registers.music_theory_en: Auto-Tune (real-time pitch correction; at strong settings, the signature robotic vocal warble)
registers.plain_ko: 음정을 기계로 딱딱 맞춰 로봇처럼 매끈하게 들리는 오토튠 보컬 효과
registers.plain_en: vocals snapped to perfect pitch with that robotic Auto-Tune sound

registers.music_theory_en: clean production (uncluttered, low-noise, well-separated modern mix quality)
registers.plain_ko: 잡음 없이 각 소리가 깔끔하게 분리되어 들리는 정돈된 프로덕션
registers.plain_en: a tidy, noise-free mix where every sound is clear and separated

registers.music_theory_en: dripping (drip-like SFX texture, or descriptive of an effect-drenched sound; ambiguous fragment)
registers.plain_ko: 물이 뚝뚝 떨어지는 듯한 소리 질감(또는 이펙트가 뚝뚝 흐를 만큼 짙다는 묘사)
registers.plain_en: a dripping-water texture, or a sound soaked in effects

registers.music_theory_en: filter sweep (gradual movement of a filter cutoff across the spectrum, opening or closing the sound)
registers.plain_ko: 필터가 서서히 열리거나 닫히며 소리가 밝아졌다 어두워졌다 변하는 효과
registers.plain_en: the sound gradually opens up or closes down as a filter moves

registers.music_theory_en: fuzz (extreme square-wave-like clipping distortion; woolly, buzzy 60s pedal tone)
registers.plain_ko: 벌이 윙윙대듯 보풀보풀하게 심하게 찌그러진 퍼즈 톤
registers.plain_en: a woolly, buzzing, heavily broken-up distortion like a 60s fuzz pedal

registers.music_theory_en: high-pass filter (attenuates frequencies below a cutoff, removing lows; thins/brightens the sound)
registers.plain_ko: 저음을 깎아내 소리를 얇고 가볍게 만드는 필터
registers.plain_en: a filter that cuts the bass, making the sound thin and light

registers.music_theory_en: low-pass filter (attenuates frequencies above a cutoff, leaving lows; darkens/muffles the sound)
registers.plain_ko: 고음을 깎아내 소리를 어둡고 먹먹하게 만드는 필터
registers.plain_en: a filter that cuts the highs, making the sound darker and muffled

registers.music_theory_en: mono (monophonic single-channel audio; no stereo width, everything centered)
registers.plain_ko: 좌우 구분 없이 한 채널로만 들리는 모노 사운드
registers.plain_en: single-channel sound with no left-right separation

registers.music_theory_en: panned (positioned toward one side of the stereo field via pan control)
registers.plain_ko: 소리를 왼쪽이나 오른쪽 한쪽으로 치우쳐 배치한 것
registers.plain_en: the sound is placed toward the left or right speaker
registers.llm_prompt: panned to one side, off-center placement

registers.music_theory_en: shutter (likely camera-shutter click SFX or gated stutter texture; ambiguous fragment)
registers.plain_ko: 카메라 셔터 '찰칵' 같은 효과음(또는 뚝뚝 끊기는 질감)으로 추정되는 표현
registers.plain_en: probably a camera-shutter click sound effect, or a chopped stuttering texture

registers.music_theory_en: slapback delay (single short echo ~60-150ms, classic rockabilly/50s vocal effect)
registers.plain_ko: 소리 바로 뒤에 한 번만 짧게 '탁' 되울리는 옛 로큰롤풍 에코
registers.plain_en: one quick single echo right after the sound, like 1950s rock'n'roll vocals
registers.llm_prompt: slapback delay, short single rockabilly echo

registers.music_theory_en: stereo imaging (control of width and left-right placement of elements in the stereo field)
registers.plain_ko: 소리들을 좌우로 배치해 넓이와 위치감을 만드는 작업
registers.plain_en: shaping how wide and where sounds sit between left and right
registers.llm_prompt: precise stereo imaging, wide spatial placement

registers.music_theory_en: instrument entrance/entry (a part joining the arrangement at a given point)
registers.plain_ko: 악기나 목소리가 곡에 새로 등장하는 순간
registers.plain_en: the moment an instrument or voice joins the song

registers.music_theory_en: instrument entrance/entry (a part joining the arrangement)
registers.plain_ko: 악기가 연주에 합류해 들어오는 것
registers.plain_en: an instrument coming into the mix

registers.music_theory_en: muted percussive guitar scratches (fret-hand muted rhythmic strums, funk 'chika' strokes) or DJ scratching
registers.plain_ko: 기타 줄을 살짝 눌러 음 없이 '착착' 긁듯 내는 리듬 소리
registers.plain_en: percussive scratchy strums on muted guitar strings, like funk rhythm 'chicka' sounds

registers.music_theory_en: drop (a sudden dynamic release point where the full beat/bass re-enters after a build-up, common in EDM)
registers.plain_ko: 긴장을 끌어올린 뒤 비트와 베이스가 한꺼번에 터져 나오는 순간
registers.plain_en: the moment the full beat and bass slam back in after a build-up
registers.llm_prompt: explosive bass drop after the build-up

registers.music_theory_en: swell (a gradual crescendo, e.g. volume swell or cymbal swell)
registers.plain_ko: 소리가 서서히 부풀어 오르며 커지는 것
registers.plain_en: a sound gradually rising in volume, like a wave building

registers.music_theory_en: continuation of a part (an instrument sustaining its pattern across sections)
registers.plain_ko: 악기가 하던 연주를 다음 구간까지 그대로 이어가는 것
registers.plain_en: an instrument keeping its pattern going into the next section

registers.music_theory_en: kick drum pattern (the rhythmic figure played by the bass drum; often the anchor the bass locks onto)
registers.plain_ko: 쿵쿵 울리는 큰북(킥 드럼)이 반복하는 리듬 패턴
registers.plain_en: the repeating rhythm played by the bass drum
registers.llm_prompt: bass locked to the kick drum pattern

registers.music_theory_en: fade (a gradual decrease in volume, e.g. fade-out)
registers.plain_ko: 소리가 서서히 작아지며 사라지는 것
registers.plain_en: a sound gradually getting quieter until it disappears
registers.llm_prompt: instruments fade out gently at the end

registers.music_theory_en: counterpoint (two or more independent melodic lines played simultaneously)
registers.plain_ko: 주 멜로디와는 다른 별개의 멜로디가 동시에 얽혀 흐르는 것
registers.plain_en: a second independent melody weaving around the main one
registers.llm_prompt: melodic counterpoint between lead and accompaniment

registers.music_theory_en: slides/glissando (pitch gliding smoothly from one note to another, e.g. guitar or bass slides)
registers.plain_ko: 음과 음 사이를 끊지 않고 미끄러지듯 이어서 내는 주법
registers.plain_en: gliding smoothly from one note to another without a break

registers.music_theory_en: strumming (sweeping across multiple strings to sound a chord rhythmically)
registers.plain_ko: 기타 줄 여러 개를 한 번에 쓸어내리며 코드를 치는 주법
registers.plain_en: sweeping across guitar strings to play chords rhythmically

registers.music_theory_en: walking bass (a bass line moving in steady quarter notes through scale and chord tones, typical of jazz)
registers.plain_ko: 베이스가 한 박자마다 한 음씩 걸어가듯 차례로 움직이는 재즈식 주법
registers.plain_en: a bass line that steps note by note on every beat, like walking

registers.music_theory_en: continuation of a part (an instrument sustaining its pattern across sections)
registers.plain_ko: 연주 패턴이 끊기지 않고 계속 이어지는 것
registers.plain_en: a musical pattern carrying on without stopping

registers.music_theory_en: fade (gradual volume decrease or increase; fade-out/fade-in)
registers.plain_ko: 소리가 점점 작아지거나 점점 커지며 자연스럽게 이어지는 처리

registers.music_theory_en: syncopated sixteenth-note rhythmic patterns (fast subdivided rhythms accenting off-beats)
registers.plain_ko: 아주 잘게 쪼갠 빠른 리듬을 정박이 아닌 엇박에 강세를 주며 치는 패턴
registers.plain_en: fast, finely chopped rhythms with accents landing off the main beats

concepts.suno_term: on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills

registers.music_theory_en: arpeggios (chord tones played one note at a time in sequence rather than together)

concepts.suno_term: the root notes of the guitar progression

registers.suno_native: the root notes of the guitar progression

registers.plain_ko: 기타 코드마다의 가장 기본이 되는 낮은 음(뿌리음)을 따라가는 것

registers.music_theory_en: swells (gradual crescendos, e.g. volume swells or cymbal swells)
registers.plain_ko: 소리가 파도처럼 부풀었다 가라앉는 볼륨 변화
registers.plain_en: sounds that rise and fall in volume like waves

registers.music_theory_en: runs (rapid scalar passages, quick successions of notes up or down a scale)
registers.plain_ko: 음계를 따라 빠르게 오르내리는 짧은 속주 구절
registers.plain_en: quick bursts of notes racing up or down a scale

registers.music_theory_en: background harmonic support (pads or sustained voicings adding harmonic richness behind the foreground parts)
registers.plain_ko: 뒤쪽에 깔린 화음이 곡을 두툼하고 풍성하게 받쳐 주는 것
registers.plain_en: background chords quietly making the harmony feel rich and full
registers.llm_prompt: sustained pads adding harmonic depth in the background

registers.music_theory_en: intensification/crescendo (a gradual increase in dynamics, density, or energy)
registers.plain_ko: 소리의 크기나 에너지가 점점 커지는 것
registers.plain_en: the volume, density, or energy gradually growing
registers.llm_prompt: energy gradually increases toward the chorus

registers.music_theory_en: melodic leaps (disjunct motion; intervals larger than a step between consecutive notes)

concepts.suno_term: a steady fingerstyle pattern with alternating bass notes and arpeggiated chords

registers.suno_native: a steady fingerstyle pattern with alternating bass notes and arpeggiated chords

registers.plain_en: fingerpicked guitar where the thumb bounces between bass notes while the fingers pick out the chord

registers.music_theory_en: mid-tempo (moderate pace, roughly 90–110 BPM range)

registers.music_theory_en: pizzicato (plucking bowed-string instruments with the fingers instead of the bow)

registers.music_theory_en: four-bar unit (phrase or loop lasting four measures)

registers.music_theory_en: strumming (sweeping across multiple strings in rhythmic up/down strokes)

registers.music_theory_en: four-on-the-floor (kick drum striking every quarter-note beat of the bar)

registers.music_theory_en: trill (rapid alternation between a note and its upper neighbor)
registers.plain_ko: 이웃한 두 음을 아주 빠르게 번갈아 떨듯 내는 장식음
registers.plain_en: two neighboring notes alternated very fast in a flutter

registers.music_theory_en: clean (undistorted, low-noise timbre; e.g. clean guitar tone without overdrive)

registers.plain_en: pure and clear, with no distortion or noise

registers.music_theory_en: distorted (clipped/saturated timbre with added rough harmonics)

registers.plain_en: gritty and crunchy, roughened by distortion

registers.music_theory_en: soft (low-intensity, gentle attack and subdued dynamics/timbre)
registers.plain_ko: 부드럽고 여린, 자극 없이 살며시 들리는 소리
registers.plain_en: gentle and quiet, easy on the ears

registers.music_theory_en: heavy (dense, powerful, often low-frequency-weighted and aggressive timbre)

registers.music_theory_en: breathy (audible breath/air noise mixed into the tone, especially in vocals or flutes)
registers.plain_ko: 숨소리가 섞여 바람이 스치듯 속삭이는 느낌의 소리
registers.plain_en: airy with audible breath, like a whispering voice

registers.music_theory_en: metallic (inharmonic overtone-rich timbre reminiscent of struck or resonating metal)

registers.plain_en: cold and clangy, like ringing metal

registers.music_theory_en: resonant (strong sustained resonance; ringing body or emphasized formant/filter peak)

registers.plain_en: ringing and full, with a strong lingering resonance

registers.music_theory_en: lo-fi (low-fidelity aesthetic: band-limited, noisy, degraded texture used intentionally)
registers.plain_ko: 일부러 오래된 라디오처럼 지직거리고 뭉툭하게 만든 빈티지 음질
registers.plain_en: intentionally degraded, fuzzy old-radio sound quality
registers.llm_prompt: lo-fi degraded texture, dusty vintage quality

registers.music_theory_en: analog (warm, slightly saturated character of analog circuitry/tape, as opposed to clinical digital)

registers.music_theory_en: airy (open, light timbre with emphasized very-high 'air' band and spacious feel)
registers.plain_ko: 공기처럼 가볍고 탁 트여 산뜻하게 퍼지는 소리

registers.plain_en: smooth and mellow, with no sharp edges

registers.music_theory_en: compressed (dynamics-flattened timbre: dense, even, punchy from compression)
registers.plain_ko: 소리 크기 기복이 눌려 빽빽하고 단단하게 들리는 상태
registers.plain_en: dense and even, with the loud-quiet swings squashed flat

registers.music_theory_en: saturated (harmonically enriched by gentle overload of tape/tube/circuit; warm thickened tone)
registers.plain_ko: 테이프나 진공관을 적당히 밀어붙인 듯 배음이 더해져 뭉근하고 진한 소리
registers.plain_en: warmly thickened and enriched, like tape pushed just past its limit

registers.music_theory_en: thick (dense, full-bodied timbre with strong low-mid weight or heavy layering)
registers.plain_ko: 여러 겹 쌓인 듯 빽빽하고 살집 있는 두툼한 소리
registers.plain_en: full and dense, like many layers stacked together

registers.music_theory_en: sub-heavy (dominant sub-bass energy below ~60Hz; chest-shaking low end)

registers.music_theory_en: low-end (the bass/sub-bass frequency region of the mix)

registers.music_theory_en: glassy (clear, bright, smooth timbre with bell-like transparent highs, e.g. clean FM/Rhodes tones)

registers.music_theory_en: nasal (midrange-honky timbre with emphasized ~800Hz-2kHz formants, pinched 'through the nose' quality)

registers.music_theory_en: woody (warm, hollow, wood-resonant timbre typical of acoustic bodies, marimba, upright bass)

registers.plain_en: warm and hollow like resonating wood
registers.llm_prompt: woody resonant timbre, warm acoustic body

registers.music_theory_en: thin (lacking low-frequency body; lightweight, small-sounding timbre)
registers.plain_ko: 저음의 받침 없이 얇고 가냘프게 들리는 소리
registers.plain_en: lightweight and small, missing bass body

registers.music_theory_en: fuzzy (soft-edged, blurry saturated texture; woolly fuzz-like grain)
registers.plain_ko: 보풀이 인 것처럼 윤곽이 흐릿하고 지글거리는 소리

registers.llm_prompt: fuzzy woolly texture, soft saturated grain

registers.music_theory_en: hollow (scooped midrange or tube-like resonance giving an empty, cavernous quality)
registers.plain_ko: 속이 텅 빈 통을 두드리는 듯 공허하게 울리는 소리
registers.plain_en: empty and tube-like, as if from inside a hollow container

registers.music_theory_en: hi-fi (high-fidelity: full-range, clean, detailed modern reproduction quality)
registers.plain_ko: 잡음 없이 또렷하고 풍부한, 음질 좋은 하이파이 사운드

registers.music_theory_en: vocals (sung human voice as a musical part, gender/register unspecified)

registers.music_theory_en: female lead vocals (a female voice carrying the melodic line of the song)
registers.plain_ko: 여자 목소리가 노래를 부르는 소리
registers.plain_en: a woman's voice singing the song

registers.music_theory_en: voice (the human vocal instrument; may refer to sung or spoken presence in the mix)

registers.music_theory_en: male baritone vocals (male voice in the baritone range, between tenor and bass, roughly A2–A4)

registers.plain_en: a deep, mid-low male singing voice

registers.music_theory_en: falsetto (a light head-voice register above the natural chest range, typically breathy and flute-like)
registers.plain_ko: 가수가 일부러 얇고 높게 내는 가성 목소리
registers.plain_en: a light, airy high voice above the singer's normal range

registers.music_theory_en: male tenor vocals (male voice in the tenor range, the higher male register, roughly C3–C5)
registers.plain_ko: 남자 목소리 중에서도 높고 시원하게 뻗는 음역의 노래
registers.plain_en: a high, bright male singing voice

registers.music_theory_en: rap delivery (rhythmic spoken-word vocal performance emphasizing flow and cadence over sung pitch)
registers.plain_ko: 멜로디 없이 리듬을 타며 말하듯 내뱉는 랩 창법
registers.plain_en: rhythmic spoken rapping instead of singing

registers.music_theory_en: vocalist (the singer performing the vocal part)
registers.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 사람, 즉 가수의 목소리
registers.plain_en: the singer performing the song

registers.music_theory_en: singing (melodic sung vocal performance, as opposed to spoken or rapped delivery)
registers.plain_ko: 말이 아니라 멜로디를 붙여 노래하는 목소리
registers.plain_en: melodic singing with the voice

registers.music_theory_en: male vocalist (a male singer performing the vocal part)
registers.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 남자 가수의 목소리
registers.plain_en: a male singer performing the song

registers.music_theory_en: vocalizing (wordless vocal sounds such as 'ooh'/'aah' or melodic humming rather than lyrics)

registers.plain_en: someone rapping over the beat

registers.music_theory_en: female vocalist (a female singer performing the vocal part)
registers.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 여자 가수의 목소리
registers.plain_en: a female singer performing the song

registers.music_theory_en: singer (the person performing the sung vocal line)
registers.plain_ko: 노래를 부르는 사람의 목소리
registers.plain_en: a person singing the song

registers.music_theory_en: female soprano vocals (female voice in the soprano range, the highest common voice type, roughly C4–C6)

registers.music_theory_en: vocal harmonies (additional vocal lines sung at consonant intervals above or below the lead melody)

registers.music_theory_en: vocal doubling (recording the same line twice and layering the takes for thickness and width)

registers.music_theory_en: ad-libs (improvised vocal interjections and fills placed around the main vocal line, common in R&B/hip-hop)

registers.music_theory_en: layered vocals (multiple stacked vocal tracks — doubles, harmonies, pads — creating a dense vocal texture)

registers.music_theory_en: call and response (an antiphonal structure where one voice or part states a phrase and another answers it)

registers.music_theory_en: unison (two or more voices or instruments performing the exact same pitch/line together)
registers.plain_ko: 여러 목소리나 악기가 같은 음을 똑같이 함께 내는 소리
registers.plain_en: several voices singing the exact same notes together

registers.music_theory_en: ad-lib (a single improvised vocal interjection or fill outside the written melody)
registers.plain_ko: 정해진 가사 밖에서 즉흥으로 내지르는 짧은 추임새 목소리
registers.plain_en: a short improvised vocal shout or fill

registers.music_theory_en: vocal harmonies (supporting vocal lines sung at intervals such as 3rds or 5ths against the lead melody)
registers.plain_ko: 주 멜로디에 3도·5도 같은 다른 음을 겹쳐 불러 화음을 만드는 소리

registers.music_theory_en: choir (a large ensemble of singers performing in multiple parts, e.g. SATB)

registers.plain_en: a large group of people singing together in parts

registers.music_theory_en: vocal harmony (a harmony vocal part sung against the lead melody at a consonant interval)
registers.plain_ko: 주 멜로디에 다른 음 하나를 겹쳐 불러 화음을 이루는 소리
registers.plain_en: a second voice singing a blending note against the melody

registers.music_theory_en: double-tracking (recording a second near-identical performance of the same vocal line and layering it for width and thickness)
registers.plain_ko: 같은 노래를 두 번 녹음해 겹쳐서 목소리를 넓고 두껍게 만드는 녹음 기법
registers.plain_en: the same vocal recorded twice and layered for a fuller sound

registers.music_theory_en: ad-libs (improvised vocal interjections and fills around the main vocal; alternate spelling of 'ad-libs')

registers.plain_en: improvised vocal shouts and fills between the main lines

registers.music_theory_en: choral (in the style or texture of a choir; multi-part massed voices)
registers.plain_ko: 합창단처럼 여러 목소리가 웅장하게 어우러지는 느낌의 소리
registers.plain_en: voices blended together like a choir
